scenes.title: A Child's Toy
scenes.summary: Late at night, a courier delivers an expensive gaming rifle that Max ordered, and after Vika calls him a child, Max has to ask her for money to pay for it.

scenes.title: The Chef's Old Friend
scenes.summary: Outside the restaurant, Chef Viktor Barinov runs into an old friend who heard he was fired, so Barinov boasts that he is now the head chef of Arcobaleno.

scenes.title: Reconciliation Dinner
scenes.summary: After Vika refuses to speak with him, Max accidentally ruins Senya's thawed kidneys and gets the idea to cook a romantic reconciliation dinner for Vika.

scenes.title: Wine for the Date
scenes.summary: Louis selects an exquisite bottle of red wine from the bar for Max's romantic dinner with Vika, assuring him he can simply buy Kostya a replacement bottle tomorrow.

scenes.title: A Gift for Elena
scenes.summary: To clear the kitchen before his friend Volodya arrives for lunch, Viktor Barinov instructs Lyova to watch for his guests and gifts Elena Pavlovna an immediate spa session.

scenes.title: Rescheduling the Visit
scenes.summary: Right after Elena leaves for the afternoon spa session, Volodya calls Barinov to cancel lunch and reschedule his visit to Arcobaleno for dinner instead.

scenes.title: Louis's Request
scenes.summary: At Claude Monet, Senya complains that his wife had a toothache during their dinner, and pastry chef Louis convinces Denis to cover his dessert station for the day.

scenes.title: The Five-Thousand-Dollar Bottle
scenes.summary: At the bar, Kostya searches frantically for a rare bottle of wine that Dmitry Nagiyev entrusted to him, and is horrified when Max admits he drank it with Vika.

scenes.title: An Expensive Mistake
scenes.summary: Max confesses to Vika that the wine they drank during their romantic dinner cost five thousand dollars, and when she scolds him, he vows to solve the problem himself.

scenes.title: French Desserts
scenes.summary: Covering for Louis at the patisserie station, Denis cannot read the French labels on the desserts and asks Senya for help, but Senya simply eats the pastries.

scenes.title: Invitation to the Restaurant
scenes.summary: When Elena Pavlovna returns refreshed from the spa, Viktor Barinov invites her to a seven o'clock dinner at Claude Monet so she will be away when Volodya arrives.

scenes.title: The Wine and Dessert Trick
scenes.summary: Max retrieves the empty five-thousand-dollar bottle from the trash and refills it with cheap wine, while at Claude Monet Barinov orders a slow pastry to stall Elena.

scenes.title: Running Between Restaurants
scenes.summary: At Arcobaleno, Lyova photographs guests on his phone so Barinov can identify his friend Volodya, and meanwhile Denis struggles to bake the pastry at Claude Monet.

scenes.title: The Counterfeit Bottle
scenes.summary: Dmitry Nagiyev arrives to reserve a VIP table and asks Kostya for his wine, and when Max hands over the refilled bottle, Vika reveals she already ordered a real one online.

scenes.title: Blueberry Sorbet
scenes.summary: Barinov excuses himself again to serve Volodya at Arcobaleno, and when Denis burns the bouchee pastry, Vika offers Elena and Barinov a quick tableside blueberry sorbet.

scenes.title: The Liquid Nitrogen Prank
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya trick Denis into making liquid nitrogen sorbet without warm water, causing his whisk to freeze solid in the bowl right in front of Elena Pavlovna.

scenes.title: Moscow's Best Sommelier
scenes.summary: When Nagiyev demands his bottle of wine, Max and Kostya stall him in the storeroom hoping Vika's courier will arrive, only to learn Nagiyev's guest is Moscow's top sommelier.

scenes.title: The Sommelier's Verdict
scenes.summary: At Arcobaleno Elena catches Barinov in the act, while at Claude Monet the sommelier identifies the wine as a cheap six-hundred-ruble bottle, making Nagiyev fire the sommelier as a fraud!

scenes.title: The Bitter Truth
scenes.summary: Elena confronts Barinov for staging such a farce to protect his ego, and when he goes out to confess to Volodya that he is just an ordinary cook, Elena saves his pride.

scenes.title: The Taste of Life
scenes.summary: At home, Max gives Vika the money from returning his gaming rifle and tells her she can return the five-thousand-dollar wine she bought—only to learn she poured it out!
